app_metadata.name: VGU Smart Lab Access Control System
app_metadata.description: JSON configuration map defining all web app URL routes, features, RBAC permissions, edge hardware decision flows, and context guidelines for the local AI Assistant.

super_admin.title: Super Admin (Full System Administrator)
super_admin.description: Highest privilege level. Has full administrative control over all labs, edge nodes, system thresholds, Lab Admin assignments, and new lab creations.

lab_admin.title: Lab Admin (Laboratory Manager)
lab_admin.description: Scoped administrative role limited to assigned labs (via labAccessIds). Manages lab users, biometric enrollments, equipment inventory, schedules, and access audit logs for assigned labs.

student.title: Student
student.description: Standard student subject. Access permissions granted based on class schedules and Access Groups.

faculty.title: Faculty / Researcher
faculty.description: Academic staff and researcher role. Extended access privileges including 24/7 or custom lab hours.

lab_assistant.title: Lab Assistant
lab_assistant.description: Student assistant supporting lab operations, equipment monitoring, and student guidance.

guest.title: Guest
guest.description: Temporary visitor account with access limited to specific time frames.

maintenance.title: Maintenance Technician
maintenance.description: Technical personnel responsible for hardware repair, camera calibration, and IoT maintenance.

logic_rules: Face match with high confidence (Confidence >= Threshold) & liveness passed -> Access GRANTED (method: face).
Face match low or uncertain confidence -> Prompt fallback 4-6 digit PIN.
Face match + correct PIN -> Access GRANTED (method: face_pin_fallback).
Incorrect PIN or liveness check failed -> Access DENIED (reason: pin_failed / liveness_failed).
Face not recognized in database -> Access DENIED (reason: unknown_user).
Network disconnection -> Edge Nodes evaluate access locally using encrypted offline manifest and reconcile with Firebase upon reconnect.

routes.title: Login Page
routes.description: Authentication gateway for Administrators (Super Admin & Lab Admin) via Firebase Auth.

routes.title: Lab Selector & Management
routes.description: Displays all available laboratories, operational statuses (Active, Inactive, Maintenance), and allows workspace context switching.

ai_guide.summary: Users must select an active lab before navigating to lab-scoped management features.
suggested_actions: Create a new lab (Super Admin only)

routes.title: Dashboard Overview
routes.description: Central hub showing key operational metrics, hardware connection statuses (Nodes, Cameras, Sync), active alerts, and real-time access events.

features.name: Real-time Metrics Summary
features.description: Total users, active nodes, today's access count, active security incidents.

features.name: Hardware Status Monitoring
features.description: Node online state (Online/Grace Period/Offline), Camera state (Connected/Disconnected), Sync state (Live/Delayed/Offline).

features.name: Live Activity Stream
features.description: Real-time feed of granted and denied access attempts.

ai_guide.summary: Provides high-level operational visibility for the active laboratory.

routes.title: User Directory & Access Control
routes.description: Manage user profiles (Students, Faculty, Staff), assign University/Student IDs, roles, lab memberships, and Admin privileges.

features.name: Search & Filter Users
features.description: Filter users by Student ID, Email, Role (Student, Faculty...), and Account Status (Active/Suspended).

features.name: Assign Admin Authority (Super Admin / Lab Admin)

ai_guide.summary: User management directory for members of the lab.
suggested_actions: Search user by name or Student ID

routes.title: Biometric & PIN Enrollment
routes.description: Capture user face images via USB/Webcam stream or file upload, set fallback 4-6 digit PINs, run photo quality checks, and upload credentials to Firebase Storage.

ai_guide.summary: Interface for registering facial biometrics and security PINs for users.

routes.title: Equipment & Asset Management
routes.description: Track lab inventory including microcontrollers, sensors, tools, and machinery. Monitor status (Available, In Use, Maintenance, Broken) and manage loan/return logs.

features.name: View Equipment Inventory
features.description: Search by Serial Number, Name, Contract Number, Invoice Number.

features.name: Flag Item as Maintenance or Broken

ai_guide.summary: Inventory asset management and loan tracking view.

routes.title: Schedules & Operating Hours
routes.description: Configure weekly lab operating time windows (Monday - Sunday), manage shift schedules, set holiday overrides, and map schedules to Access Groups.

ai_guide.summary: Schedules and shift permissions configuration page.
suggested_actions: Guide setting Student vs Faculty time slots

routes.title: Access Logs & Security Audit
routes.description: Inspect detailed access logs and audit trails. Filter by timestamp, result status (Granted/Denied), authentication method (Face/PIN), confidence scores, and export to CSV.

features.name: Advanced Log Filtering (Result, Method, Node, Date Range)

ai_guide.summary: Security logs audit trail and report generation view.
suggested_actions: Search access history for specific Student ID

routes.title: System Settings & Hardware Nodes
routes.description: Monitor Edge Node telemetry (CPU, RAM, Temperature °C, Camera FPS), adjust AI recognition thresholds (Confidence & Liveness), trigger manifest syncs, and reboot hardware services.

features.name: Monitor Hardware Telemetry (CPU%, RAM%, Temp °C, FPS)
Force Build & Push Encrypted Manifest to Nodes
Reboot Edge Hardware / AI Detection Service

ai_guide.summary: Edge Node hardware telemetry, system configs, and maintenance panel.
suggested_actions: Analyze Node CPU and temperature metrics

capabilities: Provide step-by-step navigation and guidance for Web-App operators.
Perform table data analysis on Users, Equipment, and Access Logs views.
Direct users to appropriate URL routes based on requested actions.
Troubleshoot Edge Node offline states and camera disconnection alerts.
security_guardrails: Never reveal or request raw user security PINs.
Enforce RBAC boundaries: Do not suggest or trigger Super Admin actions to Lab Admin users.
Always advise checking physical power/network connections before initiating hardware reboots.
